arxiv-2104-01732.title: Semantically Stealthy Adversarial Attacks against Segmentation Models
arxiv-2104-01732.creator: Zhenhua Chen, Chuhua Wang, David Crandall
arxiv-2104-01732.description: Abstract Segmentation models have been found to be vulnerable to targeted and non-targeted adversarial attacks. However, the resulting segmentation outputs are often so damaged that it is easy to spot an attack. In this paper, we propose semantically stealthy adversarial attacks which can manipulate targeted labels while preserving non-targeted labels at the same time.

arxiv-2207-05530.title: Camera Pose Auto-Encoders for Improving Pose Regression
arxiv-2207-05530.creator: Yoli Shavit, Yosi Keller
arxiv-2207-05530.description: Abstract Absolute pose regressor (APR) networks are trained to estimate the pose of the camera given a captured image. They compute latent image representations from which the camera position and orientation are regressed. APRs provide a different tradeoff between localization accuracy, runtime, and memory, compared to structure-based localization schemes that provide state-of-the-art accuracy.

arxiv-2302-02005.title: DeepAstroUDA: Semi-Supervised Universal Domain Adaptation for Cross-Survey Galaxy Morphology Classification and Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2302-02005.creator: A. Ćiprijanović, A. Lewis, K. Pedro, S. Madireddy B. Nord, G. N. Perdue, S. M. Wild
arxiv-2302-02005.description: Abstract Artificial intelligence methods show great promise in increasing the quality and speed of work with large astronomical datasets, but the high complexity of these methods leads to the extraction of dataset-specific, non-robust features. Therefore, such methods do not generalize well across multiple datasets. We present a universal domain adaptation method, DeepAstroUDA , as an approach to overcome this challenge.

arxiv-2312-06280.title: Adaptive Compression of the Latent Space in Variational Autoencoders
arxiv-2312-06280.creator: Gabriela Sejnova Michal Vavrecka Karla Stepanova
arxiv-2312-06280.description: Abstract Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) are powerful generative models that have been widely used in various fields, including image and text generation. However, one of the known challenges in using VAEs is the model’s sensitivity to its hyperparameters, such as the latent space size.

arxiv-2404-04309.title: An inertial self-adaptive algorithm for solving split feasibility problems and fixed point problems in the class of demicontractive mappings
arxiv-2404-04309.creator: Vasile Berinde 1,2
arxiv-2404-04309.description: Abstract . We propose a hybrid inertial self-adaptive algorithm for solving the split feasibility problem and fixed point problem in the class of demicontractive mappings. Our results are very general and extend several related results existing in literature from the class of nonexpansive or quasi-nonexpansive mappings to the larger class of demicontractive mappings.

arxiv-2411-06958.title: Data-driven discovery of mechanical models directly from MRI spectral data
arxiv-2411-06958.creator: D.G.J. Heesterbeek, M.H.C. van Riel, T. van Leeuwen, C.A.T. van den Berg, A. Sbrizzi
arxiv-2411-06958.description: Abstract Finding interpretable biomechanical models can provide insight into the functionality of organs with regard to physiology and disease. However, identifying broadly applicable dynamical models for in vivo tissue remains challenging. In this proof of concept study we propose a reconstruction framework for data-driven discovery of dynamical models from experimentally obtained undersampled MRI spectral data.

arxiv-2501-09647.title: Constraining the Secluded and Catalyzed Annihilation Dark Matter with Fermi-LAT and Planck Data
arxiv-2501-09647.creator: Yu-Hang Su a, Chengfeng Cai b, Hong-Hao Zhang a
arxiv-2501-09647.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yu-Hang Su a, Chengfeng Cai b, Hong-Hao Zhang a. We propose a dark matter (DM) model with a complex scalar charged under a hidden gauge symmetry, denoted as U ​ ( 1 ) D \mathrm{U}(1)_{\mathrm{D}} . The scalar field is the DM candidate while the U ​ ( 1 ) D \mathrm{U}(1)_{\mathrm{D}} gauge field A ′ A^{\prime} plays the role of a mediator, which connects the dark sector to the standard model (SM) sector via a tiny kinetic mixing.

arxiv-2501-13169.title: Global Turbulent Solar Convection: a Numerical Path Investigating Key Force Balances in the context of the Convective Conundrum Facilities: TGCC (Très grand centre de calcul du CEA) - CINES (Centre Informatique National de l’Enseignement Supérieur) - IDRIS (Institut du développement et des ressource
arxiv-2501-13169.creator: Quentin NORAZ, Allan Sacha BRUN, Antoine STRUGAREK
arxiv-2501-13169.description: Abstract Understanding solar turbulent convection and its influence on differential rotation has been a challenge over the past two decades. Current models often overestimate giant convection cells amplitude, leading to an effective Rossby number too large and a shift towards an anti-solar rotation regime. This Convective Conundrum, underscores the need for improved comprehension of solar convective dynamics.

arxiv-2502-15410.title: Equilibrium stresses in frameworks via symmetric averaging
arxiv-2502-15410.creator: Cameron Millar, Bernd Schulze, Louis Theran
arxiv-2502-15410.description: Abstract For a bar-joint framework ( G , 𝐩 ) (G,{\bf p}) , a subgroup Γ \Gamma of the automorphism group of G G , and a subgroup of the orthogonal group isomorphic to Γ \Gamma , we introduce a symmetric averaging map which produces a bar-joint framework on G G with that symmetry.

arxiv-2505-06945.title: Challenges and proposed solutions in modeling multimodal medical data: A systematic review
arxiv-2505-06945.creator: Maryam Farhadizadeh, Maria Weymann, Michael Blaß, Johann Kraus, Christopher Gundler, Sebastian Walter, Noah Hempen, Hannah Bast, Harald Binder, Nadine Binder
arxiv-2505-06945.description: Abstract Background: Multimodal data analysis has gained significant attention in biomedical Artificial Intelligence. Integrating diverse data sources, such as omics, wearable sensors, imaging, environmental, and electronic health records, offers a more comprehensive view of patient health and supports personalized care. However, modeling multimodal data poses several challenges that must be addressed to ensure accurate and reliable analysis.

arxiv-2510-16021.title: Feature-driven reinforcement learning for photovoltaic in continuous intraday trading
arxiv-2510-16021.creator: Arega Getaneh Abate, Xiufeng Liu, Ruyu Liu, and Xiaobing Zhang
arxiv-2510-16021.description: Abstract Photovoltaic (PV) operators face substantial uncertainty in generation and short-term electricity prices. Continuous intraday markets enable producers to adjust their positions in real time, potentially improving revenues and reducing imbalance costs. We propose a feature-driven reinforcement learning (RL) approach for PV intraday trading that integrates data-driven features into the state and learns bidding policies in a sequential decision framework.

pmc-11356207.title: High-Resolution Rotation-Measuring System for MEMS Ultrasonic Motors Using Tunneling Magnetoresistance Sensors
pmc-11356207.creator: Jiangbo He, Qiuyue Feng, Yu Chen, Tianyu Yang, Xiaoshi Li, Wu Zhou
pmc-11356207.description: This study proposes a high-resolution rotation-measuring system for miniaturized MEMS ultrasonic motors using tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR) sensors for the first time. Initially, the architecture and principle of the rotation-measuring system are described in detail. Then, the finite element simulation is implemented to determine the miniaturized permanent magnet’s residual magnetization, dimensions, and TMR sensor position.

pmc-11643475.title: The Formation of γ-Valerolactone from Renewable Levulinic Acid over Ni-Cu Fly Ash Zeolite Catalysts
pmc-11643475.creator: Margarita Popova, Silviya Boycheva, Ivan Dimitrov, Momtchil Dimitrov, Daniela Kovacheva, Daniela Karashanova, Nikolay Velinov, Genoveva Atanasova, Agnes Szegedi, Sreekantha B Jonnalagadda
pmc-11643475.description: Zeolites with different structures (P1, sodalite, and X) were synthesized from coal fly ash by applying ultrasonically assisted hydrothermal and fusion–hydrothermal synthesis. Bimetallic catalysts, containing 5 wt.% Ni and 2.5 wt.% Cu, supported on the zeolites, were prepared by a post-synthesis incipient wetness impregnation method.

pmc-12607032.title: Signal relay in C. elegans: A tissue-perspective on coordinating organismal proteostasis and its impact on aging
pmc-12607032.creator: Loren Cocciolone, Akhil Souparnika, Valeria Uvarova, Katie Kessler, Patricija van Oosten-Hawle
pmc-12607032.description: As the global demographics shifts towards an increasingly aging population, understanding the effects and molecular mechanisms underlying aging becomes more and more important within biomedical research. A hallmark of aging is the progressive deterioration of protein homeostasis (proteostasis), characterized by the accumulation of misfolded protein aggregates within the cell.

pmc-13225482.title: Effects of oxycodone and sufentanil on the quality of recovery after laparoscopic total hysterectomy: A randomized controlled trial
pmc-13225482.creator: Zhongyu Liu, Shanliang Guo
pmc-13225482.description: Background:To compare the effects of oxycodone and sufentanil on the quality of recovery after laparoscopic total hysterectomy.Methods:Ninety patients scheduled for laparoscopic total hysterectomy between January and December 2023 were randomly divided into 2 groups: oxycodone group (Group O) and sufentanil group (Group S), with 45 patients in each group.

pmc-13383687.title: Stretchable, Tough, and Luminescent Perovskite Molecular Ferroelectric Composite: Empowering Reliable Self‐Powered Motion Sensing in High Humidity and Subzero Temperatures
pmc-13383687.creator: Shuangqing Li, Zhe‐Kun Xu, Zheng Xing, Jin‐Wang Liu, Yong‐Quan Wu, Peng‐Fei Li, Zhong‐Xia Wang
pmc-13383687.description: Piezoelectric materials for wearable biomechanical sensing require high flexibility, including the mechanical capacity to endure stretching and bending deformations, etc. However, existing strategies for flexible composites embedding typically brittle piezoelectric crystals into polymer matrices still suffer from limited stretchability and mechanical strength, falling short of dynamic, all‐day wearable scenarios.

pmc-13414606.title: Feasibility Study of Nose-to-Brain Delivery of Galantamine for Alzheimer’s Disease: Enhancing Olfactory-Region Deposition to Improve Therapeutic Efficacy
pmc-13414606.creator: Chuangxin Chen, Chunying Leung, Zizhao Zhai, Guanlin Wang, Rui Yang, Qiuyi Hu, Xiao Yue, Zhongxuan Yao, Ziyu Zhao, Xuejuan Zhang
pmc-13414606.description: Background: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the seventh leading cause of death worldwide, posing a substantial global health burden. Although galantamine (GNT) is a first-line clinical drug for AD treatment, its therapeutic efficacy is constrained by inefficient brain delivery across the blood–brain barrier (BBB). Nose-to-brain delivery represents a promising route to bypass the BBB.

pmc-13425765.title: Understanding child mental health care pathways in community-based services: a qualitative study in a French child and adolescent medico-social centre (CMPP)
pmc-13425765.creator: Camille Augustin, Vera Ivanaj, Fabienne Ligier
pmc-13425765.description: BackgroundChild and adolescent mental health is increasingly recognized as a major public health concern worldwide. However, access to timely and coordinated mental health care remains uneven, particularly for children experiencing psychosocial, developmental or learning difficulties. Fragmentation across health, social care and education systems often contributes to discontinuous care pathways, especially in resource-constrained and rural settings.

pmc-13452154.title: Metabolic signature across Life's Essential 8 profiles is heterogenous and may predict cardiovascular disease and mortality
pmc-13452154.creator: Ian M Pollack, Jiaxuan Duan, Justin Swanson, Hongtian Wang, Kevin Kip, Steven E Reis, Chris McKennan, Anum Saeed
pmc-13452154.description: BackgroundLife's Essential 8 (LE8) is an American Heart Association framework of modifiable behaviors and factors for measuring cardiovascular health. However, the underlying metabolic signature of individual LE8 metrics is less known. The purpose of this study is to identify the metabolites associated with all 8 components of LE8 and evaluate association with adverse cardiovascular events.

pmc-13489161.title: The Relationship Between Schizotypy and Latent Inhibition and Conditioned Inhibition
pmc-13489161.creator: Liam Myles, Lucy Cheke, Jane Garrison
pmc-13489161.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Salience Hypothesis suggests that people high in symptoms of schizophrenia aberrantly assign salience. Studies of this theory are typically limited by confounds of learned irrelevance, conditioned inhibition (CI), negative priming, and novel pop-out effects. This study circumvented these confounds by using a perceptual learning (PL) paradigm to examine the effect of schizophrenia symptoms and hallucination proneness (HP) on latent inhibition (LI) and CI.

pmc-13494008.title: Adaptive filtering method for reducing signal saturation induced artifacts in X-ray dark-field tomography
pmc-13494008.creator: Henrik Mäkinen, Heikki Suhonen, Simo Huotari

pmc-13521511.title: CD1d remodels the tumor-infiltrating myeloid populations controlling antitumor immunity
pmc-13521511.creator: Lauren Evans, Maria Conde Poole, Cenk Celik, Harshita Mishra, Michael J Pitcher, Anita Grigoriadis, Maria Secrier, Patricia Barral
pmc-13521511.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). identify CD1d as a key regulator of myeloid cell diversity in breast cancer. CD1d targeting reshapes tumor immune infiltrates, suppresses tumor growth, and enhances immunotherapy efficacy, suggesting an actionable pathway for therapeutic intervention. Introduction

Myeloid cells, including macrophages, dendritic cells (DCs), monocytes, and granulocytes, represent a major component of the tumor microenvironment (TME) in solid tumors, and they are critically involved in the regulation of tumor growth, vessel formation, metastasis, and response to treatment (Lopez-Yrigoyen et al., 2021).

pmc-13552218.title: Serum C1q as a Novel Predictive Biomarker for Postoperative Delirium After Acute Type A Aortic Dissection
pmc-13552218.creator: Jianing Wang, Yi Jiang, Wenxue Liu, Yapeng Wang, Shan Lu, Jiawei Zhu, Xiujuan Cai, Yuhuan Tian, Yongqing Cheng, Dongjin Wang, Yunxing Xue
pmc-13552218.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to evaluate the predictive value of C1q (complement activation regulatory factor) for the occurrence of postoperative delirium (POD) following surgery for acute aortic dissection.MethodsWe prospectively included patients undergoing surgery for aortic dissection. Serum levels of C1q were measured preoperatively and on the first postoperative day.

pmc-13563863.title: Mitochondrial transfer via ADSC-EVs reprograms glucose/glutamine metabolism to restore TCA cycle-driven M2 polarization in diabetic wounds
pmc-13563863.creator: Yue Zhang, Fei Han, Yixuan Yuan, Mengyang Li, Linbin Yi, Yujie Xiao, Dongliang Zhang, Zhi Zhang, Yunchuan Wang, Hongtao Wang, Dahai Hu
pmc-13563863.description: Chronic diabetic wounds are trapped in a persistent inflammatory state, largely due to macrophage failure to transition from pro-inflammatory (M1) to pro-reparative (M2) phenotypes. Here, we show that adipose-derived stem cell extracellular vesicles (ADSC-EVs) deliver functional mitochondria into diabetic wound macrophages, thereby restoring tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle-driven M2 polarization.
